import sys

def main() -> None:
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    n = len(s)
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    rev = s[::-1]
    # KMP prefix function on s + '#' + rev
    combined = s + '#' + rev
    lps = [0] * len(combined)
    for i in range(1, len(combined)):
        j = lps[i - 1]
        while j > 0 and combined[i] != combined[j]:
            j = lps[j - 1]
        if combined[i] == combined[j]:
            j += 1
        lps[i] = j
    longest_pal_pref = lps[-1]          # length of longest prefix of s that is a palindrome
    ans = n - longest_pal_pref
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
